verdict.rationale: CDP documents an Offramp that converts crypto into fiat and deposits it to bank accounts. It also documents fiat payouts from a custodial account over ACH, Fedwire, Swift and SEPA, plus auto-conversion of USDC to USD, so the core stablecoin-to-bank path exists. The evidence does not show a published list of supported currencies or countries. missing for 10: published set of supported fiat currencies and countries, end-to-end stablecoin-to-local-bank recipient flow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops lead, recipients can land in local fiat — documented off-ramp rails that convert stablecoins into bank transfers across a published set of currencies and countries

citations.quote: Send fiat out of a custodial account using ACH, Fedwire, Swift, or SEPA rails
Converts crypto into fiat currency and deposits to bank accounts
Send payouts and disbursements from a custodial account to onchain addresses, email recipients, or bank accounts via fiat rails.
Accept customer USDC, auto-convert it to USD, and collect it in your treasury
